title: Book 8 — Urania, Chapter 23
paragraphs: Themistocles, then, had set up these inscriptions. To the barbarians, immediately after these events, there came a man of Histaia in a boat bringing word of the Greek retreat from Artemisium. They, however, not believing it, kept the messenger under guard and sent swift-sailing ships to scout ahead. When these reported the facts, at last, as daylight was spreading across the sky, the whole armament sailed as a body to Artemisium. Having remained there till midday, they then sailed on to Histaia, and on arrival took possession of the city and overran all the villages along the coast in the region of Ellopia, which is the land of Histaia.
